description: This file defines API interaction functions for fetching project data, metrics, and suggestions, including seed data for fallback scenarios. It manages API URL resolution, fetch requests, and exports public functions for use in a frontend application.

methods.name: getApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Determines the base URL for API calls based on environment variables or window location.

methods.name: getJson
methods.description: Performs a fetch request to retrieve JSON data from a specified path.

methods.name: seedProjects
methods.description: Provides seed project data for fallback.

methods.name: seedMetrics
methods.description: Provides seed metrics data for fallback.

methods.name: seedSuggestions
methods.description: Provides seed suggestions data for fallback.

methods.name: fetchProjects
methods.description: Fetches list of projects from API or returns seed data on failure.

methods.name: fetchMetrics
methods.description: Fetches metrics for a specific project or returns seed data on failure.

methods.name: fetchSuggestions
methods.description: Fetches suggestions for a specific project or returns seed data on failure.

methods.name: getResolvedApiBaseUrl
methods.description: Returns the resolved API base URL for diagnostics.
